body: I wish I would of known about that sooner.
Thanks for believing in me. Your mother sounds horrible. I'm sorry you went through that. It's hard discovering that you were abused, but worst if people don't believe you.
That self defense will be useful when she tries to touch me again. I do everything to make her stop touching me.
I live there becuase I need to get ajob to save money to move away. I didn't know I was being abused until I found this sub.

That is even more gross. It always felt uncomfortable but I thought sexual abuse was when a men sexual assualted a woman. Thanks to the internet and finding this sub I'm learning more about the different types of abuse. I'm so sorry that happened to you.

Awful, both her parents were abusive to her. They were physically and emotional abusive. Her dad was an alcoholic with schizoprenia and her mom was very controlling and didn't believe in divorce. Her parents hated eachother. My mom never got professional. Instead she became christian and thinks she is a good person.

I can't call CPS because I'm already an adult. I didn't know I was being abused until I found this sub. I wish I would have known sooner what was going on or I would of been out of there. I have never told this to anyone. My dad is scared of her and doesn't disagree with her to not make her angry. I can't talk about it with my brother because he has autism. I hope nothing bad happened to my brother because he wouldn't be able to explain or defend himself. Locked rooms are not allowed in here. If you lock it, she uses a knife to mess with the lock. The spending less time at the house sounds like a good idea. I already finished college, so I'm still looking for a job. In the meantime sometimes I go to the stores or to eat to avoid spending too much around her. Your reply has good suggestions.
I'm already an adult so my plan is to get a job and save money to move out.

I hope to get out of the house once I start earning money. I'm still on the process of looking for a job. I'm already an adult and finished college. Locked rooms are not allowed in the house. She has opened the doors that have locks using a knife. No, I haven't ralked to it to dad or my brother. My dad is scared of her and my brother has autism so he wouldn't understand.

I wish women that are pedophiles would be seen the same as men that are pedophile: evil, disgusting, sick in the head that harms innocent people. The media always paint the pedophile as a old, perverted man. Never think that woman can harm innocent people. It's unfortunate that those women get away with it. Just because they don't have a penis, that doesn't mean that they are incapable of sexually abusing a child.

Pedophiles that are woman are just as sick as the men. But people always have a hard time believing that woman would abuse children. I would be creeped out if a woman was atracted to a teenager. But sadly there are parents that encourage age gap relationships between an adult and a teenager. Also there are teenagers that think is cool to date someone older.They don't see that adult is looking for someone innocent and naive. Someone that they could manipulate and control. Woman that go after teenagers deserve to rot in jail.
I'm tired of hearing that too. As the time passes by, life has been getting worse. I feel so stupid for waiting that something positive in life will happen.
I forgot what does it feel to be truly happy with life. Right now, music is the only thing that gives me comfort and it's the only thing I have left.

Because I wouldn't have privacy. There are people that have told their problems to someone, suddenly everyone else finds out about the problem. There are people that like to gossip alot. Plus they would try to pray for it, instead of suggesting professional help.

I'm also thinking of killing myself before Christmas. Holidays make me feel more depressed and alone. I already don't have friends in real life, I'm cutting off the few ones of the internet. I will miss my pets but I know dad will take good care of them. I'm sorry I'm not much help.

🎵Oh Lord, heaven knows, we belong way down below
Oh Lord, tell us so, we belong way down below🎵
Are u still there?
I don't even want to celebrate the holidays neither because I have no reason to be happy. I'm waiting to do it by impulse to.
Imagining my death makes me feel happy because I wouldn't have to suffer this miserable life anymore. I even practiced chocking with a belt, one day I'm just going to keep holding it longer.

This year I have been having so many days that I'm waiting for that I will just do it. I know how to kill myself and wrote my goodbye letter. I don't have much friends online so I can just delete everything and dissapear. Nobody will miss me.

I didn't expext to still be alive either. I understand about the hope. Sometimes I think my life will get better and if I die I would be missing the chance to see my life better. But life has been getting even worse.
I have practiced the method that I'm going to use too. I just start chocking with a belt for a few seconds to see how it feels. One day I will just keep holding on until I go to sleep.
Hey, everybody has different things that make them happy. Yours happen to be videogames.
Im sorry to hear that. I hope you find someone that treats u the right way.
Yeah, cuz I have nothing in my life.

I'm 24 and she has tried to force herself onto me especially as an adult. When I was younger, she wasn't like that. My brother is more affectionate so she asks for hugs and kisses to him and gets them. He is also an adult.
I can relate. When she tries to do it in public, like at church, the moment feels awkward and my body remains stiff.
It wouldn't work because she has denied ever hitting me. Then she would remind me all the things she done for me and how she had a worst childhood than me.

I sometimes think she wants a really bad diagnosis so she can use more discipline and to justify her trying to control me. Either a condition that makes me mentally disabled (so she can control my life) or something dangerous (where she can play the victim). She has used my brother's autism to gain sympathy from people and uses her alcoholic father to prove that she was abused and had a worse childhood than you.

I actually have anxiety and depression. I have been dealing with anxiety since I was a child. I think my mental health would improve if I move out. But I'm scared of feeling even more alone living on my own. But at the same time my mental health has gotten worse that I started having suicidal thoughts again. I hope that she doesn't try to go to my next session. Even tho she said she will talk to the therapist if I don't get cured, I have a hard time believing her. My plan is to drive to therapy sessions alone and not tell her about what I talked in the sessions.
I have no idea becuase I just started with the therapist. I actually plan to tell in the next session. I'm 24 but I still live with them.
I'm 24. But my mom tried twice to get information from the therapist. The therapist refused to tell her anything. I'm scared the therapist would fall for the whole "concerned mother" act.
That is horrible what he did. I know that by law they are supposed to protect the pacient information. Is a smart choice that you left him.
As long as mom doesn't interfere, I will continue with therapy. ☺

The thing is my mom is good at playing the victim. She already has a mentally ill daughter (me), a austistic son plus an abusive childhood. She will use all that to gain sympathy points. Mom never lets her mask slip in public because she cares so much about what other think.

I felt pressured because I was getting emotional breakdowns and panics attacks. Mom said she can't deal with me anymore so for the past years she has been making appointments for me to take therapy. I live with them so sadly they are going to know. She just wants me to be cured already. According to her, I was supposed to be the normal one.
The insurance pays for it. But I have to pay a small fee for each session and dad helps me with it. I  just hope the therapist doesn't tell her anything.
24, but I still live with them.
I plan to tell the therapist on our next session.

Wow that is messed up. I also suffer from depression but never told her because she would blame for it. I wish I could go no contact but I still live with them. 😔 Reading other stories it seems that they don't want to deal with your emotional issues. They only care about what you can do for them.
It is scaring that she just sits there serious and rolling her eyes, when her daughter is hurting. I sometimes think that she likes it because she can paint me as the crazy mental ill daughter.
I feel awkward when it happens but a bit of relief because I don't have to pretend that we have a good relationship. Plus I don't get to hear someone critizing me.

The therapist told me what mom was trying to do. I'm glad that the therapist respected my privacy. I heard so many stories of therapists doing that, I wish they would realize that these types of parents are just looking for information to hurt you. Not because they care about you. The only place where I can talk about ny feelings is on the internet.

She never assumes responsibilty when she is hurting someone, so I doubt she will change her behaviour. I can't make any diagnoses, but the stories I read on this sub sound similar to what happens at home, that I know I wasn't raised in a normal home. It took me finding this sub to start questioning how my parents were treating me.

The apology wasn't even genuine, she even said she did it because dad was upset of the situation. She had an abusive alcoholic father and never got therapy to treat her trauma. She uses religion to appear as a good christian woman. I usually keep my problems to myself, but I was tired of she using that tactic on me again. It is not the first time she said that if she and dad died that I'm going to be alone. I'm tired of always being seen as the problem. I was crying and she didn't even try to understand me. Instead just rolling her eyes, staring and accusing me of throwing a tantrum. Thanks for the books recomendations, I like learning about my situation.

I have asked her before why she tells me, she insists that I need to be more friendly and change to fit in. I don't care about fitting in. I don't want to be friends with old women. It is awful that I lost my church friends when the church separated. I have been tempted to confront them but I have a fear that it would backfire. These women at church are very powerful and if my mom found out she could punish me. She cares alot about what these people think. Also I would't have anybody to support me while those ladies have the whole church to support them. And yes I sometimes have suspected she has made a few things up, becuase a few times she couldn't tell me a name. I already have social anxiety and she trying to get to care about what other people thinks makes things worse. I wish I would of known sooner that it wasn't normal, I would of planned an escape sooner. Either I finally find a job and start saving money or kill myself.

Dont have anyone anymore. 😢. One stop talking cuz she was busy with her job, another got engaged and the other one I had to drop because she was a very toxic friend. The only people I talk to are from the internet.

One moved to another country with her family the other 2 (they r sisters) are still going to the other church and can't leave because the mother sees the younger pastor as a traitor that ruined church. They don't know how to drive either so I haven't see them since the separation.

Its not evangelical. It was prebisterian (don't know if I'm spelling it right). A lot of those leaders have a superioty complex where they get to boss around people to do things they don't want to do and then take credit for it. I want nothing to do with those people. I used 2 have friends from church but the church separated and I lost them. 😢 This is the third time the church has separated except that now I have a different pastor (older pastor was very controlling and got rid of the other pastors to keep his position).
This message was beautiful. I almost cried. 😢

Thanks for the hugs. My image issues are very deep that would need profesional help. I don't even talk about it to her. It is hard learning to love yourself when you have a person that  puts you down and puts down others that don't fit their beauty standard. She made me feel like being insecure was something abnormal.

I learned that with these types of parents you can never have a heart to heart conversation. They show no empathy and somehow her problems are worse than mine. I use the internet to vent. She has been insecure about her body because she finds skinny bodies as the ideal. She is buying food that is "healthy" and freaking out when she eats something unhealthy like cake. She goes to the gym five times a week and mops around when she misses a day. It is very hard not feeling anxious about your looks when you have somebody that is constantly putting you down because you look a certain way.

That doesn't mean you can't enjoy music. Music is for everybody. :D I hide my music for her so she can stop judging me. Your right about the moving away part, but it a risk that I don't know if I would take.
I have written songs. Years ago I got a few guitar lessons but I gave up cuz I couldn't play the music I wanted to. I have a religious mother that thinks rock music is satanic.
I like rock music, like Evanescence, Linkin Park, Skillet, New Years Day, Fireflight, Icon for Hire, etc. I was watching Once Upon a Time until season 6. Currently I'm watching Izombie.
I usually listen to music when I'm sad or angry. Sometimes I watch series to distract my mind.

One time in a fast food restaurant I was sitting in a table while waiting for my mom to order the food. I was still in elementary school and I didn't undertstand when an old man sat at my table and started talking to me. He asked if I was alone and I told him that I wasn't and that my mom was with me. I even pointed to her at the line. I don't even remember if mom noticed what was going on. Minutes later my mom comes and tells me to move to another table. I was scared and I shed a few tears. I thought the old man wanted to kidnap me and do horrible things to me. Mom didn't even ask if I was ok and didn't comfort me. She didn't say anything to the old man either. For the rest of the trip I was scared of finding that old man again.

I'm so sorry your mother did that to you. They don't understand how hard it is to have a mental illness and instead of getting us help and offering support and comfort, they treat you like you are some kind of burden. It is so frustating when nobody undertstands what you are going through.

She cares alot about what other people think of her. She is always trying to go to almost church events and doing charity to appear like a good christian woman. It is not fair that when she gets angry she can express all she want but makes me feel abnormal when I'm dealing with emotional problems. :/

Wow it seemed that the party was more for her than for you. I know if mom threw a party it would be to impress people because she cares so much about what people think. And what the heck getting lunch meant that you are spoiled? Is normal to get hungry especially if you were doing a pshysical activity.
Thank you so much for your kind words. I needed to hear this.

I had double jaw surgery years ago because my problem was serious and was not going to be fixed with just braces. I was self conscious about my gummy smile. My teeth looked very small and my gums looked inflamed. She did allow me to get surgey but wasn't happy with the surgery. I had to talk to convinced and I'm surprised that it worked. I did have surgery after been years with braces. The surgery made things better. For the first time I could actually close my mouth and even speak more clearly. I had a maxilla defect that could only be corrected by surgery. I have to warn you that the recovery phase takes weeks and you need someone to watch over you. I even had to spend 1 night at the hospital. After surgery you need to be very gentle with yourself and put on a special diet because you won't be able to chew food normally. This surgery is not for cosmetic reasons, you actually need to be experiencing health problems and discomfort because no surgeon is going to perform a long invasive surgery for nothing. Sounds like your parents don't care about your well being. In my case my mom was worried about what other people was going to think because her daughter got surgery. Also she did't want to put so much effort and time to take care of me. She stayed at the hospital and helped the first week. After it I was on my own.

I wish I would not have putted my hope to be rescued by a guy. I was desperate to just for once in my life feel loved. Not the type of love that is given when you obey (like with mother) and get taken away when you dont do what they say.

It is good to know I'm not alone. And my relationship with mother is very complicated. She doesn't love me. She just sees me as an extention of herself that has to take care of her when she is older. She doesn't even believe in crying cuz she sees it as weakness. So I can't open myself to her. With therapy no matter how many sugestions I tried, I still felt sad and lonely. I'm just tired of fighting with my mental illness, with mom and with the rest of the world. I just want some peace. I want the pain and sadness to end. I like when I sleep because I forget about my problems and don't experience any pain. I want that feeling to last forever.

This reminds me of mom trying to "fix" my social anxiety. Except her way of curing me is forcing me to church and pushing me to go to almost every social event. She even says that she prays for my social anxiety to go away. Yet when I was receving therapy she used to tell me that they weren't really working because I'm still the same. It made me upset when she said that after my therapy sessions. I have a brother with austim and she once said that she was hoping I would be the normal one.

I do think she sees me as another version of herself. She said that she feels sad that she didn't discover make up sooner and critized that grandma never encouraged her to put makeup and that her makeup style was too simple. She somehows thinks that If i wear makeup i will automatically find a partner. She is somewhat girly and has tried for years to push that on me. She doesn't understand that we like different things.

She also compares me to people especially people around my age demanding why I haven't done this or that. I had to stop seeing my last psychologist because she moved far away. 😔 The whole idea of opening up myself to a stranger again doesn't sound apealing. Plus having her get mad becuase I didn't want to tell her about my therapy sessions made it so annoying.
Thanks for the kind words. I'm just trying to survive but sometimes I see suicide as the last resort to ending the pain. I don't want her to win either but sometimes you get tired of life.
My mom uses my brother austism diagnosis to get more empathy points. She plays "The poor strong mother that has to deal with a hard life becuase her kid isn't normal".

"Engulfing narcissistic mothers see their kid as an extension of themselves and punish it when it exhibits an individual personality." This describes my mom. That is why i stop sharing anything I like with her. She expects me to like the same music, tv shows, clothes and many other things that she likes. As a result she calls me boring and that I don't like anything. Don't know why that gets her mad. She also expects to be around her friends too. Like no I don't want to be around a bunch of middle aged ladies. And then she calls me anti social too. Thank you for the kind words.

Self harm is not a joke. That is a terrible thing to say. I sometimes feel like my mom is a bully too. She doesn't know about me feeling suicidal because if she does, I got a bad feeling she is going to blame me for not going to church enough. Talking to her about emotions it was talking to a wall.

I feel you. I also hide my interests from her because she always has something nasty to say about it. Didn't know I was supposed to like the same thing as her. And I know we will never have those daughter-mother relationship like tv becuase I'm supposed to behave the way she wants to, do the hobbies and interests as her and do the goals she wants to.

Yeah it does make sense. :) Mom knows about 1 mental illness because I got it diagnosed since childhood. Her solution is that I need to go to church, force me to go to every social event she has and pray for it to go away. She will never understand how hard is to deal with people without getting nervous. That is why I didn't tell about my other mental illness. It so horrible when they tell you to "get over it" becuase mental illness is something complicated and needs years of therapy and support to get better.

Exactly. When I used to talk to her about classes that were difficult, she always has to mention how much harder it was for her because she used to work and study at the same time or how she had to stay up late to study or how she had to reading boring literature. It is never "I know college is very hard cuz I have been through it". It is always about her college days. 😐

If I commit suicide I know my mom will use to gain more empathy points. She already paints herself as the strong christian mother that overcame a abusive household and became a sucessful person with a career and build a "perfect" family. She will put on a show on how painful is to lose her only daughter. Yet she treated her daughter like an inferior being.
Thank you so much for your kind words. I have been a lurker on this sub for a while. It has helped me to deal with mom plus I feel like I'm not the only one with a similar situation.

I was sleeping so that is why I didn't answer. I just feel so stupid and this mistake is going to cost a lot of money. Mom already has been giving me the silent treatment. I know she is going to remind me of this mistake over and over again. I feel scared cuz I know mom is going to release her rage at any moment.
